annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously states that a server MAY omit sending a 100 (Continue) response if it has already received some or all of the content for the corresponding request, or if the framing indicates that there is no content. The conditions are clearly defined and do not leave room for multiple materially different implementation behaviours.
